Total Banks Loans
► +192 mln (+0,2%) w/w · -43 mln vs Budget · +454 mln vs EoM Aug. Slightly positive week, driven by BIB (+36 mln) and ISP RO (+36 mln). Below Budget mainly because of ISP ALB (-78 mln) and VUB (-69 mln). The week closes 82% of the gap to Budget.

Total Banks Loans & Deposits
► Total Banks Loans: -43 mln vs Budget · +454 mln vs EoM Aug. Negative, entirely due to ISP ALB (-78 mln); Alex (+90 mln) and ISP RO (+59 mln) go the other way.
► Total Banks Deposits: +56 mln vs Budget · +443 mln vs EoM Aug. Positive, entirely from Alex (+101 mln); ISP ALB (-67 mln) and VUB (-58 mln) go the other way.

Total Banks Loans (1)
VS BUDGET – BUDGET PERFORMANCE
► Total Banks Loans (1) as of week 25/09/26 is below Budget by -43 mln (-0,1%). The shortfall is mainly driven by ISP ALB (-78 mln, -0,9%).
► Partly offsetting, positive contributions come from Alex (+90 mln, +1,8%).
VS PREV. WEEK – WEEKLY MOMENTUM
► Total Banks Loans (1) increased by +192 mln (+0,2%) versus the previous week. The strongest positive contributions are recorded in BIB (+36 mln, +0,9%).

Total Banks Deposits
+180 (+0,2%) w/w. Slightly positive week, driven by Alex (+36) and ISP ALB (+36).

VS BUDGET – BUDGET PERFORMANCE
► Total Banks Deposits as of week 25/09/26 are above Budget by +56 mln (+0,1%). The strongest positive contributions versus Budget are recorded in Alex (+101 mln, +2,0%), ISP RO (+70 mln, +0,9%) and BIB (+48 mln, +1,2%).
► On the downside, the main negative deviations versus Budget are recorded in ISP ALB (-67 mln, -0,7%), CIB (-36 mln, -0,6%) and ISP BiH (-14 mln, -0,1%).
VS PREV. WEEK – WEEKLY MOMENTUM
► Total Banks Deposits increased by +180 mln (+0,2%) versus the previous week. The strongest positive contributions are recorded in Alex (+36 mln, +0,7%), ISP ALB (+36 mln, +0,4%) and CIB (+24 mln, +0,4%).
► No material negative country contribution was recorded during the week, with the remaining countries broadly stable or positive.
